purpose: Document first-party cadastral discovery and bounded anonymous service attempts for Khandwa.
assessment: The Khandwa district administration and Madhya Pradesh land-record services are verified first-party sources. Direct anonymous requests to the current MP Bhulekh/WebGIS and Khandwa GIS hosts timed out, so no parcel geometry or adapter qualification is claimed.
registryAssessment: Local/district registry custodian found: the Khandwa district Office of the Superintendent of Land Records and its official public-service links are evidenced. The DILRMP page is national status reporting and is not treated as the local custodian.
